In production, this would validate against a user database.

post.description:
Handles multipart/form-data uploads for image files.
Uploaded files are intended to be pinned to IPFS.
Handles application/json uploads for generic structured data.

schema.description: Arbitrary JSON data to upload to IPFS

AnalysisDetails.description: Detailed results of an incident analysis.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the analysis (0.0 to 1.0).

recommended_actions.description: List of recommended actions to mitigate the incident.

should_report.description: Whether the incident should be reported to authorities.

AnalysisResponse.description: Response payload containing incident analysis results.

agents_used.description: List of AI agents used during analysis.

fallback_active.description: Whether fallback logic was active during analysis.

AnalyzeIncidentRequest.description: Request payload for analyzing an incident.

networkState.description: The current state of the network.

block_height.description: Block height at which the transaction was confirmed.

drone_id.description: Drone identifier associated with this event.

evidence_cid.description: IPFS CID of evidence linked to this event.

oneOf.description: Geographic location associated with the event.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the event was recorded.

CreateIncidentRequest.description: Request to create a new incident.

oneOf.description: Geographic location where the incident occurred.

blockchain_tx.description: Blockchain transaction hash anchoring this evidence.

captured_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the evidence was captured.

drone_id.description: Identifier of the drone that captured the evidence.

gateway_url.description: IPFS gateway URL for accessing the evidence file.

incident_id.description: Incident this evidence is linked to, if any.

model.description: The model name used for the query.

blockchain_records.description: Blockchain transaction hashes anchoring this incident.

evidence_count.description: Number of evidence items associated with this incident.

oneOf.description: Geographic location where the incident occurred.

drone_id.description: Filter evidence by capturing drone ID.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp upper bound for filtering by capture time.

incident_id.description: Filter evidence by associated incident ID.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp lower bound for filtering by capture time.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp upper bound (inclusive) for filtering by creation time.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp lower bound (inclusive) for filtering by creation time.

altitude.description: Altitude in metres above sea level.

NetworkRequirementsRequest.description: Request payload for network requirements analysis.

networkState.description: The current state of the network.

NetworkRequirementsResponse.description: Response payload for network requirements analysis.

recommendations.description: List of recommendations for the network.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp upper bound for event time.

incident_id.description: Filter events by associated incident ID.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp lower bound for event time.

QueryGeminiRequest.description: Request payload for querying Gemini AI.

block_height.description: Block height at which the transaction was included.

error_message.description: Error message if the transaction failed.

cid.description: Content Identifier (CID) of the uploaded file on IPFS.

drone_id.description: Identifier of the drone making the attestation.

is_valid.description: Whether the location attestation is valid.

min_alt_m.description: Lower altitude bound in metres AGL

max_alt_m.description: Upper altitude bound in metres AGL

treasury.description: Base58 treasury account for crossing fees
